infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ToolKit uses the camera only when you choose to capture post or message media.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ToolKit accesses selected photos and videos for posts, profiles, and messages.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: ToolKit can use Face ID to lock the app when you enable biometric lock.
